concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-payto-android-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured PayTo Android Drop-in Sessions/Advanced add-on for one-time and subscription agreement flows, later-payment route, webhook finality, and source example/token-field cautions.
warnings: Sessions subscription field table requires storePaymentMethod=true but its example omits it (raw lines 129, 161–193).

Agreement prose names RECURRING_CONTRACT recurringDetailReference (raw lines 218/507), required-webhook sections name its pspReference token (249/607), and later-payment table requires recurring.token.created.data.storedPaymentMethodId (516); no single mapping or interchangeability is established.
